skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand key terms and concepts in the source language.
Memorize key terms and concepts in the source language.
Translate key terms and concepts accurately into the target language.
Analyze sentence structure in the source language.
Translate sentence structures accurately into the target language.
Deliver translated content fluently in the target language.
Take notes efficiently during translation tasks.
Develop self-study habits to improve translation skills.
Demonstrate responsibility for the quality of translations.
Adhere to ethical standards in translation practice.
